original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudFormation template to create a CloudWatch Dashboard for monitoring a
  Lambda-based API's health, including invocations, errors, throttles, and
  duration.

Parameters:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: The name of the Lambda function to monitor.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+"

Resources:
  LambdaApiHealthDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub '${LambdaFunctionName}-API-Health'
      DashboardBody: !Sub
        - |-
          {
              "widgets": [
                  {
                      "height": 6,
                      "width": 12,
                      "y": 0,
                      "x": 0,
                      "type": "metric",
                      "properties": {
                          "metrics": [
                              [ "AWS/Lambda", "Invocations", "FunctionName", "${LambdaName}" ]
                          ],
                          "view": "timeSeries",
                          "stacked": false,
                          "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                          "stat": "Sum",
                          "period": 300,
                          "title": "Invocations (Sum)"
                      }
                  },
                  {
                      "height": 6,
                      "width": 12,
                      "y": 0,
                      "x": 12,
                      "type": "metric",
                      "properties": {
                          "metrics": [
                              [ "AWS/Lambda", "Errors", "FunctionName", "${LambdaName}", { "color": "#d62728" } ]
                          ],
                          "view": "timeSeries",
                          "stacked": false,
                          "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                          "stat": "Sum",
                          "period": 300,
                          "title": "Errors (Sum)"
                      }
                  },
                  {
                      "height": 6,
                      "width": 12,
